instruction: Please add a one-hour tutorial session on Thursday at 10 AM to my weekly course timetable.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Course Timetable.xlsx, navigated to cell D5 (Wednesday 12:00), typed 'Lecture 2 (12:00-14:00)', set yellow background, and saved. Completed in 11 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open LibreOffice Calc files, navigate to specific cells, type text, change cell background colors, save files
metadata.task_rationale: Variation adds a tutorial (green) instead of a lecture (yellow) on a different day/time, testing the same cell-editing capability with a different target
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a tutorial entry in cell E3 (Thursday, 10:00). Getter reads cell E3's value and background color. Metric checks value contains '10:00' and '11:00' keywords and background is green (92D050).

scoring_breakdown.text_content: 0.5 - Cell contains tutorial text with '10:00' and '11:00'

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell E3 (Thursday, 10:00 slot) value and background color from Course Timetable.xlsx using openpyxl
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('required_keywords') and expected.get('expected_color')
Postconfig properly activates the Calc window and saves the file before getter reads state
Color substring match ('92D050' in 'FF92D050') correctly handles openpyxl's alpha-prefixed RGB format
Partial credit scoring (0.5 text + 0.5 color) is reasonable for this two-aspect verification

Minor gap: No explicit check for 'tutorial' keyword in cell text - the green color (92D050) serves as a proxy to distinguish tutorials from lectures (yellow), but an entry like 'Lecture (10:00-11:00)' with green background would incorrectly pass

Minor gap: Time keywords '10:00' and '11:00' assume colon-based 24h format; if agent writes '10 AM - 11 AM', the check fails. However, the original trajectory used '12:00-14:00' format, making this a reasonable assumption for this timetable
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'tutorial' (case-insensitive) to required_keywords to verify the entry type, not just the time and color: "required_keywords": ["tutorial", "10:00", "11:00"]
Consider adding alternative time format patterns (e.g., '10 AM', '10am') to be more robust against different agent formatting choices
